5e75b06c44e344b4b39b9b8a7377bfd3-1.description: Face biometric authentication via PingOne Recognize WebSDK.

apiKey.description: API Key generated in the P1Recognize tenant under Access Control. Supports ESV references using dot notation e.g. esv.p1recognize.apikey
apiKey.title: API Key

enableCameraInstructions.description: Show camera instruction steps before biometric capture begins
enableCameraInstructions.title: Enable Camera Instructions

errorSubmitDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after a biometric error before submitting. Default 3000. Set to 0 to submit immediately.
errorSubmitDelay.title: Error Submit Delay (ms)

finishedSubmitDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after a successful biometric before submitting. Default 3000. Set to 0 to submit immediately.
finishedSubmitDelay.title: Finished Submit Delay (ms)

hidePoweredBy.description: Hides the PoweredBy footer displayed on all screens.
hidePoweredBy.title: Hide Powered By Keyless

publicKey.description: The public key used as part of the image encryption process. The publicKey is available via an HTTP GET to the {{baseURL}}/v1/customers/{{tenant_name}}}/image-encryption endpoint. Remove all \n newline characters and the -----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY----- and -----END PUBLIC KEY----- tags from the publicKey before using it in the node configuration.
publicKey.title: Public Key

publicKeyId.description: The ID of the public key used as part of the image encryption process. The keyID is available via an HTTP GET to the {{baseURL}}/v1/customers/{{tenant_name}}}/image-encryption endpoint.
publicKeyId.title: Public Key ID

sdkLanguage.description: Explicit language override. If set, takes precedence over auto-detection. Leave blank for auto-detection. (e.g. en, fr, de)
sdkLanguage.title: SDK Language (override)

sdkLocalization.title: SDK Localization

sdkTheme.description: Controls which color palette the SDK component uses
sdkTheme.title: SDK Theme

sdkThemeOptions.description: JSON to align to UX theme option changes. e.g. {"colors":{"light":{"primary":"#1E69D2","onPrimary":"#fff","surface":"#fff","onSurface":"#000"}}})
sdkThemeOptions.title: SDK Theme Options

tenantEnvironment.description: The regional location of the provisioned P1Recognize tenant.
tenantEnvironment.title: P1 Recognize Tenant Region

tenantName.description: The P1Recognize tenant name, shown as customer name within the P1Recognize tenant.
tenantName.title: P1 Recognize Tenant Name

webSdkVersion.description: Version of the P1Recognize Web SDK. Default is 2.3.0.
webSdkVersion.title: Web SDK Version
